Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-80003m.json runs/final-case-80003m-r1
6 candidates all with fairly close support (~0.14-0.18). Let's run diagnostics.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 1 --why "Earliest reachable slot with maximal 4-sigma separation across six live candidate pairs including the closely spaced period aliases, preserving all later high-value slots for follow-up"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 2 --why "Candidate five is the current leader and this earliest available slot gives four-sigma separation against every rival pair involving it, directly testing the leading hypothesis"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 4 --why "Earliest slot reaching the four sigma separation ceiling, resolving the third versus fourth ranked candidate pair while also giving strong partial separation on the current top two leaders"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 8 --why "Earliest slot at the four sigma separation ceiling, simultaneously testing candidate one against four rivals including the two closest competitors in the current tied leaderboard"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 10 --why "Earliest four sigma slot targeting the leader against its strongest remaining rival while also covering three other live pairs at maximal separation"

python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --slot 24 --why "Final budgeted observation, chosen for the single highest separation available on the decisive leader versus second place pair to confirm the resolution as strongly as possible"

content.text: Budget exhausted with candidate 0 at support 0.865 — below the theta=0.997 resolution threshold. Time to finalize honestly as a strong-but-unresolved lead.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/final-case-80003m-r1 --why "Budget exhausted with candidate zero the clear leader at eighty six percent support after six discriminating observations that eliminated three aliases outright, but support falls short of the strict resolution threshold so this is reported as a strong lead rather than a confirmed resolution"

content.text:
Campaign complete for **case-80003m** (`runs/final-case-80003m-r1`):

- Used all 6 observations, progressively eliminating candidates 1, 4, 5, and nearly candidate 3.
- Final support: **candidate 0** (P=0.911d) at **0.865**, candidate 2 (P=10.49d) at 0.127, candidate 3 at 0.008 — three aliases (1, 4, 5) driven to zero support.
- Result: **abstained** — candidate 0 is a strong, clear leader but fell short of the θ=0.997 resolution threshold, so the run correctly reports no confirmed selection rather than overclaiming.
